tasks.title: Set up PostgreSQL database schema with products, inventory, users, and alerts tables
Implement Node.js/Express backend API with WebSocket support for real-time inventory updates
Build React mobile UI components for Home Dashboard, Barcode Scanner, and Alerts Center screens
Integrate Barcode Scanner API and implement barcode scanning functionality with camera access
Develop real-time inventory tracking with WebSocket connections and synchronization logic
Implement low stock alert system with threshold configuration and push notifications
Create Product Management CRUD operations with API endpoints and UI forms
Build Sales Reporting dashboard with charts, date filtering, and export functionality
Design and implement Settings screen with user profile, alert configuration, and preferences
Implement authentication and role-based access control for Store Owner, Manager, and Clerk roles
Optimize mobile UI responsiveness and accessibility with touch targets and WCAG compliance
Conduct end-to-end testing of barcode scanning, inventory updates, and alert workflows

risks: WebSocket connection stability may cause synchronization delays in real-time inventory updates across multiple users
Barcode Scanner API compatibility issues across different mobile devices and operating systems
Database performance degradation with high-frequency inventory updates and concurrent user access
Push notification delivery failures or delays for low stock alerts may impact timely reordering
Scope creep from Sales Reporting feature complexity could delay MVP delivery timeline
